cliSmokeResults.validate: PASS (19/19 on a fresh PREPARED skeleton)

remainingLimitations: Authorization detection remains heuristic for arbitrary non-canonical key names, but TASK_STATE now requires the exact canonical boolean matrix and rejects unknown *Authorized keys set true, closing the practical gap for governed task state.

CI-time git-history immutability across stages is enforced through the append-only changed-file boundary plus per-file MANIFEST hashing; the workflow relies on GitHub-provided base/head SHAs which it now verifies before use.

Higher declared states (SOURCE_TRUTH_REVIEWED and above) require a conservative stage marker file; the deep semantic validation of those stage artifacts remains the responsibility of the corresponding governed review/validation tasks.
